biuret.definition:
n. A white, crystalline, nitrogenous substance, C2O2N3H5,
   formed by heating urea. It is intermediate between urea and cyanuric
   acid.

biuret reaction.translation:
[化] 双缩脲反应
[医] 双缩脲反应

biuret reagent.translation: [医] 双缩脲试剂, 盖斯氏双缩脲试剂

biuret test.translation: [医] 双缩脲试验(检蛋白质及尿素)
